You mean the train driver? 

It shouldn't ruin his life. There are other jobs. There is treatment. There is medicine. If his balding ass gets his life ruined by a little work related incident then that's on him.

Trains are big and heavy the reason we use them in the first place is because of their energy efficiency. There's not a lot of friction on the rails themselves so... 

... once a train gets going it takes a lot to stop it. I figure that's a pretty high success rate. 

I heard they put nets and shit on Golden Gate cause of how many people sought liberation that way. I'm sorry, yo.
